title: ticket-conformance
description: Validates that a ticket under docs/tickets/ follows all required conventions.

objective_length_max.description: Objective section must be ≤ 1 sentence (≤ 200 chars)

has_do_not.description: Scope & Boundaries MUST contain at least one 'Do not' line

sections_ordered.description: Section headings appear in a required order

max_section_lines.description: No section block may exceed this many lines

files_table_complete.description: Every file referenced in steps appears in the Files table

no_unresolved_todos.description: Must not contain uncompleted TODO/FIXME unless tagged to a ticket

validation_errors: HEADING_FORMAT_REQUIRED: Line 1 must match '# Ticket NNN — description'
NUMBER_GAP: Ticket numbers must start at 0 or 1 with no gaps
FILENAME_MISMATCH: ticket-NNN-* filename number must match heading number
MISSING_SCOPE_DO_NOT: Scope & Boundaries must contain 'Do not' or 'Do NOT'
SECTIONS_OUT_OF_ORDER: Sections must appear in the documented order
MISSING_VERIFICATION: Every ticket must have a 'Verification' section or test command
FILES_INCOMPLETE: All referenced files must be listed in the Files table
SECTION_TOO_LONG: No section block exceeds 100 lines
UNRESOLVED_TODO: Found uncompleted TODO/FIXME without a ticket reference

auto_fixes.fix_description: Add en-dash separator and zero-pad number if needed
Move sections into documented order (scaffolding only)
